text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N3 requires threads to be kept soft and retapped after surface treatment, but no thread feature or dimension exists anywhere on the drawing for this pin. This contradiction will confuse manufacturing about whether a threading operation is required; the designer should remove the thread-related instructions from N3 or add the missing thread dimensions.","recommended_correction":"Remove items 3 and 4 from note N3, or add the appropriate thread dimensions and features to the drawing if threads are actually required."}]}
